title: A compact title bar and deeper menus
summary: The title and menus now share one row. Expanded File and Image submenus make planned actions easier to find while preserving document protection.

Improved: Integrated title/menu row with the document name, unsaved marker, minimize, maximize/restore, and close controls.
Title dragging and edge resizing, with a minimum window size that keeps the editor controls available.
File Import and Print submenus, separate Rename and Duplicate entries, and nested Image Arrange, Align, and Rotate menus.
Individual unfinished menu actions retain red provisional target labels and cannot modify the document.
Closing a modified image still opens Save and continue, Discard, and Cancel. Cancel preserves the document and Undo returns to the saved state.

limitations: Full interface parity remains in progress. Detailed properties, dialogs, Assets, capture controls, library and video views are incomplete.

Custom chrome does not yet support dragging a maximized window to restore it or native Windows snap layouts. Use the restore button or double-click the title first. Additional DPI and keyboard/accessibility checks remain pending.
The new Import, Print, Arrange, Align and Rotate menu entries expose planned work; their operations are not implemented.
Screen capture, global hotkeys, clipboard, callouts, effects and history are not included. Red version targets are provisional.
Text uses a dialog, two bundled fonts and basic left-to-right layout. Windows x64 portable alpha; not code-signed.
Editable projects retain original image pixels. Share flattened PNGs when redacting content.
